name: Fire Elemental

actions.name: Burning Touch
actions.effect: Flammable objects touched ignite. On a critical hit, the target catches fire (1d6 fire per round until extinguished).

actions.name: Fire Sweep
actions.effect: The elemental surges forward in a 9m line. All creatures in the line must pass PHYS save or take damage and catch fire.

actions.name: Ignite
actions.effect: All flammable objects in a 3m radius burst into flames. Creatures in the area take 2d6 fire damage.

reactions.name: Flare Up
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack from within reach, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage as the elemental's body flares.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.desc: Can move through spaces as narrow as 2cm. A creature that touches or hits the elemental in melee takes 1d6 fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: Sheds bright light in a 9m radius and dim light for an additional 9m.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.desc: For every 5 liters of water splashed on it, the elemental takes 1d6 cold damage.

lore: Fire Elementals are living columns of flame drawn from the Elemental Plane of Fire. They consume everything flammable in their path with mindless hunger, leaving nothing but ash and cinder.
